newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria state Feb industrial sales down 24.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria state Feb industrial sales down 24.2 pct.

text.p: Receipts from sales of Bulgaria's state industrial sector fell a real 24.2 percent in February against the same month last year, the National Statistics
"Shrinking domestic demand due to the economic crisis has led to a decline in sales," a NSI official told reporters. @

Receipts from sales in the state industrial sector totalled 867 billion levs at current prices last month, figures showed. Receipts from sales for the first two months amounted to 1,272 billion levs, down a real 14.1 percent year on year.
Domestic and foreign sales of the state and the private sectors amounted to 1,066 billion levs at current prices in February, down a real 22.4 percent from the same month last year. @
Industrial sales of the state and the private sector in January and February amounted to 1,541 billion levs, a real 12.6 percent fall compared to the first two months of last year.

The share of industrial exports from both sectors within the total sales volume rose to 39.3 percent in the first two months of the year from 32.4 percent in January and February 1996, the NSI said. @

Receipts from industrial exports rose a real four percent in the January-February period year-on-year mainly due to the fall in the lev on the domestic market from around 600 at the beginning of the year to about 2,000 at end-February.
* NOTE: The NSI stopped releasing monthly figures for industrial output from January and will announce them quarterly instead.
